changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[WorkflowSteps] AS select S.ItemID, S.StepID, S.StartedBy, S.StartedOn, S.CompletedBy, S.CompletedOn, V.Name as StepName, case V.ActivityType when 1 then 'Email Notification' when 2 then 'Status Change' when 3 then 'Form' when 4 then 'Procedure' when 5 then 'Field Change' else 'None' end as ActivityTypeName from workflow.ItemStep S inner join workflow.VersionStep V on V.ID = S.StepID
